item.title: Adult brain shows greater self-repair capacity than previously known
item.description: New research in mice reveals that the adult brain may have a stronger ability to heal itself, with a special group of support cells playing a key role.

item.title: Ozempic may uncover brain's hidden 'craving center'
item.description: Drugs like Ozempic appear to reduce not only hunger but also cravings for alcohol and other addictive substances, prompting scientists to investigate further.

item.title: Researchers identify a brain rhythm that may enhance deep brain stimulation for Parkinson's
item.description: A study has identified a specific brain network and its electrical rhythm that may underlie the effectiveness of deep brain stimulation for Parkinson's disease.

item.title: Starlink satellites repurposed to probe Earth's upper atmosphere
item.description: Scientists have developed a novel method to map a hard-to-observe region of the upper atmosphere using orbital data from Starlink satellites.
